## Problem and change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues if applicable.

## Checks

List relevant commands/results and platforms checked. Mention checks you could
not run. For prose-only changes, checking links and examples may be sufficient.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] The change is focused, and its PR title follows Conventional Commits.
- [ ] Relevant tests, examples and documentation are updated where needed.
- [ ] Changed C/C++ files follow the repository's formatting and conventions.

New contributors: see [the first-PR guide](https://github.com/Pranav-32/Clutch/blob/main/docs/CONTRIBUTING.md#your-first-pull-request).
Report vulnerabilities through [private reporting](https://github.com/Pranav-32/Clutch/security/advisories/new).
